p=pathlib.Path('/Users/radoniusz/Library/Developer/CoreSimulator/Devices/BD1DCA41-5F4A-4EAF-A7F9-A641D2384C2B/data/Containers/Data/Application/84A2FAE0-845A-468A-B5C1-777CDE5D51B2/Library/Application Support/xyz.blueskyweb.app/RCTAsyncLocalStorage_V1/6b4d31064d04d1c547f0f2deeac0ba07')
state=json.loads(p.read_text())
a=next(x for x in state['session']['accounts'] if x.get('active'))
base=a['service'].rstrip('/')
token=a['accessJwt']
def get(path, params=None):
    url=base+'/xrpc/'+path
    if params: url+='?'+urllib.parse.urlencode(params)
    req=urllib.request.Request(url,headers={'Authorization':'Bearer '+token})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=8) as r: return json.load(r)
def post(path, body):
    req=urllib.request.Request(base+'/xrpc/'+path,data=json.dumps(body).encode(),headers={'Authorization':'Bearer '+token,'Content-Type':'application/json'},method='POST')
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=8) as r: return json.load(r)
feed=get('app.bsky.feed.getTimeline',{'limit':1})['feed']
item=feed[0]['post']
if item['record'].get('text') != 'Mochi napping in a sunbeam 🐱 #caturday' or item['author'].get('handle') != 'whiskers.test':
    raise SystemExit('Timeline head did not match the inspected first post; no action taken.')
existing=item.get('viewer',{}).get('repost')
if existing:
    print('Already reposted:',existing)
else:
    record={'$type':'app.bsky.feed.repost','subject':{'uri':item['uri'],'cid':item['cid']},'createdAt':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec='milliseconds').replace('+00:00','Z')}
    result=post('com.atproto.repo.createRecord',{'repo':a['did'],'collection':'app.bsky.feed.repost','record':record})
    print('Created repost:',result.get('uri'))
verified=get('app.bsky.feed.getTimeline',{'limit':1})['feed'][0]['post']
print('Verified first-post viewer repost:',verified.get('viewer',{}).get('repost'))
print('Verified repost count:',verified.get('repostCount'))
PY
